shots.prompt: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon game animation of EXACTLY the boy in the image: same pot helmet, ginger hair, freckles, serious frowning face, ragged grey-green tunic, boots, pitchfork, same thick hand-inked outline and muted colours. No walking.
